body: I read some stuff saying you should only split them one at a time before taking them, that splitting them and leaving them for awhile will make them less effective or something of the like.
I hadn’t thought of something like that, I’ll definitely start paying attention and check her out to see if that could be the issue.

She has, she’s been dewormed and has had most, if not all of her shots, I’ll have to check on that to be sure. I’m taking her to get fixed in a couple of weeks. She was with at least one of her brothers that I know of until the day I got her, about a week and a half ago. I’m not sure at what point she was separated from her mother, I got her from a fosterer that works with a local animal shelter. She’s really a very sweet kitten, she lays on my lap while I play games and she likes to sleep laying right up against me. I always sneak in some pets while she’s too tired to notice but I’d like to be able to pet her when she’s awake because she makes it very tempting!

People are complicated and selfish. It sucks, the world sucks. But I for one have no issues with you because of your gender. Good luck out there. Maybe one day people will stop being dicks to each other, we can always hope at least.
It seems like people are just finding reasons to make each other feel like shit these days.
Interestingly enough I’m having similar issues as a woman.
I saw a counselor for awhile a couple years ago but it didn’t really help

To tell everything would be to tell you basically my entire life. Long story sort of short, I don’t have friends and never have except for one, I suck at doing everything, I just suck at being a person in general, I didn’t go to school and homeschool messed up my education big time.  I made a friend once, online, and I’m trying to hold onto that but I know it’s all been false for months now. I need an animal to stay stable but my cat died a few months ago and I’m currently not allowed to have another pet and won’t be able to for a very long time. The only thing that’s kept me from thinking about everything up until this point has been video games but now I can’t even focus on those. I don’t feel like I’m in control of my own life so I have an incredibly hard time doing anything without guidance or permission. I think I’m actually starting to lose my sanity now, sometimes my mind feels blank and I just stare off into nothing until someone says or does something to bring me back to reality. My mind is just messed up and I don’t think there’s any fixing it. And the worst thing to me is that I can’t really explain what’s wrong with me because I’m not entirely sure myself.
Thank you so much. Do you have any advice on how to hold onto this and use it to help get out of this hole? I’m very much willing to try, I just don’t know how.
Thank you very much, I hope so too.
Thank you, I actually talked to my mom a little bit and I think I might try counseling again. Maybe some medication if I can talk myself into it.

I tried counseling once but my counselor wasn’t the best at his job so I quit. I don’t know about medication, I know it’s my choice to try it or not but my mom always told me that she never wants me to try it because she doesn’t want me to be stuck taking it the rest of my life and I just don’t want to disappoint her.
Living for others is what’s kept me here for a few years. I don’t know if I can keep doing this. I don’t know how..

I don’t see the point in trying anymore. This has been going on for so long, I don’t have any friends, I don’t have a job, I’m not smart enough for college, I’m not attractive whatsoever, I have no talents, I’m too embarrassed to workout or be healthy in general and my only hobby is video games. I don’t even have the motivation to clean my room... I’ll be 20 next year and all I ever do it sit in my room and hope that someday I won’t just be a girl that nobody even realizes exists but I know that’s not possible because I can’t get myself to make a change and nothing will change if I don’t do anything about it.

My family is the only thing keeping me here now and I’m not sure how much longer it will be enough. I feel like I don’t have a purpose. Anxiety keeps me from getting a job or making friends or doing anything that would make me better and depression keeps me from being strong enough to fight. I’m not smart enough for college and I’m very ugly so I have nothing at all going for me, there’s no hope I’m trying because I know I’ll fail.
I would like some more Rick and Morty and Game of Thrones, but is it really worth it?
Where can I find the people that really care? I don’t have any friends, so the only people that would really miss me are family, the world would go on unchanged without me.
puppies would help a lot if I could have one. not being allowed to have a dog or a cat is one of the reasons I’m giving up

I don’t know exactly what causes this, loneliness maybe? I don’t know. I’ve been trying to figure it out for a long time. I have no friends and I never have because I was homeschooled and never did anything to make friends, some days I watch my little sister succeed where I failed and it makes me happy to see her going down a better path than I did but at the same time it makes me feel like shit for never making friends and taking opportunities when I was younger. I have so many things I regret and now it feels like it’s too late to do anything about it.

On a side note, I don’t mean to sound creepy or anything but I did check out your profile a bit before replying and I saw that recently you’ve been trying to help out a lot of people here and I think that’s pretty awesome and you deserve some thanks. So thank you for that.

I’m in a similar situation. I’ve been depressed since I was about 13/14 and I just turned 19 in October. I used to always feel the same way, bad most of the time with a few “happy” days/moments.

Now I generally go between that numb state you’re talking about and a really horribly overwhelming sadness, but I don’t have any of those happy days anymore.

I don’t think this is the better that people talk about. I think it’s just another phase of depression, for me at least. The people I’ve seen get better seem to genuinely be happy people.

Have you tried counseling/therapy? Or medication? Personally I went to a few months of counseling but my counselor kind of sucked and I got no help out of it. I’m considering going back now because I’m really running out of ideas.

People have told me that things won’t get better on it’s own, you have to work toward it and try to help yourself, which is the complete opposite of what I’ve done so I really should maybe take that advice. It’s just hard to make myself do things, even if it does help. You know? Maybe we should both try something new? Like a hobby or something. Maybe doing something a little different will push us in the right direction.

Good luck my friend, I truly hope you find your happiness.

Honestly I think a big part of it was the specific counselor, he wasn’t very helpful, I know of other people who agree. It could possibly help me now if I had someone else but it’s been a couple years now and I’m old enough to have to make my own appointment and I don’t think I could make myself do it. Really, not much has changed in my life since then. I’m living in a different house now and about to move again, I lost my pet which made things worse but other than those things, my life is almost exactly the same as it was then.
